import polars as pl


def transform(raw: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    null_values = ["", "N/A", "n/a", "-", "null"]

    def parse_text(col: str) -> pl.Expr:
        return (
            pl.col(col)
            .str.strip_chars()
            .replace(null_values, None)
            .str.to_uppercase()
        )

    def parse_int(col: str) -> pl.Expr:
        return (
            pl.col(col)
            .str.strip_chars()
            .replace(null_values, None)
            .cast(pl.Int64, strict=False)
        )

    def parse_number(col: str, factor: float = 1.0) -> pl.Expr:
        return (
            pl.col(col)
            .str.strip_chars()
            .replace(null_values, None)
            .cast(pl.Float64, strict=False)
            .mul(factor)
            .round(2)
        )

    return raw.select(
        order_id=parse_text("id"),
        line_no=parse_int("lines.n"),
        sold_at=pl.col("ts")
        .str.strip_chars()
        .replace(null_values, None)
        .str.to_datetime(format="%Y%m%dT%H%M%S", strict=False)
        .dt.cast_time_unit("us"),
        store=parse_text("store_id"),
        sku=parse_text("lines.sku"),
        qty=parse_int("lines.qty"),
        unit_price=parse_number("lines.price_cents", 0.01),
        discount=parse_number("lines.discount_cents", 0.01),
        line_total=parse_number("lines.total_cents", 0.01),
    )
